blockers.sought: The actors' union, the Unión de Actores del Paraguay, ratified a tariff in 2017: on a feature film a day pays at least PYG 500,000 for a lead, 450,000 for a co-lead, 400,000 for a supporting part and 200,000 for an extra, and a shoot of up to 60 days at least PYG 13 million (lead), 11 million (co-lead) or 8 million (supporting); in advertising a day pays PYG 600,000 (lead), 500,000 (secondary) or 300,000 (extra); the working day is up to ten hours and payment is due within 30 days. (Finding withdrawn 2026-11-01: its only source, Última Hora, 2 May 2017, rests on the Unión de Actores del Paraguay's tariff, which is not published and whose union has no site, which names no published primary; it lands again on the UAP's published tariff or a page of it at INAP or the Labour Ministry.)
